purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Beni Mazar

queries.query: Beni Mazar Egypt official cadastral parcel map land registry API
queries.result: No Beni Mazar-specific first-party parcel viewer, cadastral API, or public parcel feature response was found. The relevant first-party lead was the Egyptian Survey Authority (ESA), whose site describes surveying, land-record, historical-map, and digital-map services, but the observed public pages did not expose Beni Mazar parcel data.

queries.query: بني مزار مصر خريطة مساحية سجل عقاري رسمي
queries.result: Arabic discovery identified first-party ESA material and a Beni Mazar tax-office page, but no Beni Mazar cadastral parcel viewer or anonymous parcel API. ESA's Arabic governorate map page links to Minya directorate imagery and office information, not parcel features; the tax page is not a cadastre source.

officialSources.observation: First-party Egyptian Survey Authority landing page identifies the authority as responsible for maps and land/property survey records and links to map services.
First-party historical zemam-map page is an ASP.NET form with governorate/center selectors; the initial public response showed Cairo/Abbassia and no Beni Mazar parcel layer or feature API.
First-party image-map page provides governorate directorate/office image links, including Minya; it is not a parcel viewer and exposes no parcel schema, CRS, IDs, or geometry.
First-party digital-map page describes a request/purchase workflow for digital maps rather than an anonymous downloadable parcel service.
First-party Egyptian Tax Authority page confirms Beni Mazar tax-office coverage, but it is not cadastral or parcel-map evidence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: ESA national survey/map custodian pages and Minya directorate lead were inspected; no local Beni Mazar parcel service was exposed.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No Beni Mazar parcel response, safe native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or full polygon geometry was verified.

remainingUncertainty: The absence of a public Beni Mazar parcel endpoint in the inspected pages does not prove citywide cadastral absence. Historical/digital map products may require an office request or non-public workflow. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS-disabling exception was used. No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel identity and polygon were observed. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
